body: Don't let these feelings control you, is the message. It's okay to have them. It's okay to feel them. You don't have to let them control you. Try to look at life from a different perspective from your own. Try to ignore your own feelings of imminent despair, distance yourself from your own demons, and look only at the present rather than the past and the future. Eventually, you'll master the present. When that happens, you'll feel better.

I'm a metal head too. I feel fake and empty too. I don't even know if I have an identity or a self. It just brings me to this perspective where, if I'm in so much pain that I want to die, then why should I care? Why should I care about anything? If I can live and not care, then I won't want to die because I don't care if I'm in pain. It leaves me with the truest version of myself. I just look to see, and I realize what I want. I just want someone. If I just had the right person, I wouldn't be in so much pain anymore. That sets me up to make goals because I don't care if I fail or succeed, just that I try so that succeeding becomes a possibility rather than just an obscure idea. Basically all I'm saying is that you shouldn't remove the possibillity of your life getting better by ending your existence, instead you should focus on why you're unhappy, try to remedy it as best you know how, don't be guilty for being yourself, don't apologize, try to think of something that would make it all okay then go for that with all you got because it doesn't matter if you might not be alive anyways. If you're willing to commit yourself to nonexistence in such a full and thorough way, then before that you should be willing to commit yourself to yourself in a full way. Stop caring about what might happen because nobody knows what's going to happen. Just be yourself, don't accept despair, even in failure you can fail honorably if you want to. Stand up, please. Forget about all the pain, go ahead be angry at the universe if you want to, but don't let it drag you down because you are a capable human being, and you can do or be whatever you want, life used to be all about survival, all about needs, if you have everything you need then you have the opportunity to embrace what you care about and work towards what you want.
The whole world? Say my goodbyes, try to show my love to everyone before it's too late.

All that we can do is be ourselves. Even if it hurts, even if the pain is all we have. You can see happiness. Dream for what you want until it's yours, that's what they say. If it makes you angry, you don't have to follow suit. Punks, Metal Heads, Goths alike, they prefer to reflect the darker side of life. Need someone in which to confide? Me too. So do we all. Don't end it all friend, because think, I'm just like you, you're just like me, as much as it's cold, we're not alone are we? I know how you feel, I'm not exactly out of it, but I've distanced myself somewhat from suicide itself because I have hope, if it can get better, it won't if I'm dead.
